pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
begin
  pdf_bytes = File.read("text/plain.txt").bytes
  result = Xberg.pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
